dict.string: TrackerApp uses Bluetooth to find another nearby iPhone running TrackerApp and swap the tokens it needs to measure the distance to it, and to detect indoor positioning anchors.

TrackerApp uses the camera to improve direction accuracy when locating a nearby iPhone on models that require camera-assisted Nearby Interaction, and to track your position while placing anchors for indoor positioning.
TrackerApp uses Nearby Interaction (Ultra Wideband) to measure the precise distance and direction to another nearby iPhone running TrackerApp.
